english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Fasting of the Saints
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter is entirely institutional/ecclesiastical instruction about fasting practice. While it references substrate cosmological concepts (ruling-power in the body, soul entering through food, darkness-mixture, the Cross, the living soul), these concepts are DEPLOYED to justify fasting — not TAUGHT as cosmic architecture. Both sides of the mapping never stay within the cosmic system: one side is always the institutional practice of fasting by 'the holy man' or 'the saints.' The four-fold enumeration is structured around 'works' of fasting, not cosmic domains or correspondential registers. No extractable oldest-layer teaching exists as a self-standing unit. The chapter represents the compilers' ecclesiastical instruction drawing on cosmological vocabulary that the audience would already know from actual substrate teaching elsewhere.
